resources.string: Enables full voice control, hardware toggles, and screen actions dynamically in English and Hindi.

1. Grant Microphone and Screen Overlay permissions if requested.
2. Enable the service in Accessibility Settings.
3. A glowing AI assistant orb will appear floating on your screen.
4. Drag the orb anywhere. Tap it once to initiate Voice Assist.
5. Speak any command in English or Hindi, e.g. "Volume Badhao" or "Torch On".

• "Volume Up" / "Volume Badhao"
• "Volume Down" / "Volume Kam Karo"
• "Torch On" / "Torch Jalao"
• "Torch Off" / "Torch Band Karo"
• "Restart Mobile" / "Phone Restart Karo"
• "Open YouTube and search Punjabi song"
• "Scroll Down" / "Go Home"
